name: Jordan Lee
headline: Senior Product Manager | Payments and Risk
summary: Product manager with eight years in payments and risk. I ship fraud models with the guardrails around them, and I measure every launch against chargebacks and false declines.

entries.desc: fraud platform used by about 400 online merchants

bullets.text: Cut false declines **from 3.1% to 1.4%** by shipping a review queue that sends borderline orders to people instead of auto-declining them.
Set the launch criteria for a new fraud model at a two-week shadow run, with rollback if chargebacks rose.
Killed a planned rules editor after interviews showed merchants wanted fewer settings, and shipped presets instead.
Wrote the dispute playbook the team still uses, which halved time to first response.
